description: The GJ-34 Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO) serves the Chhota Udepur district, which was officially formed in 2013. The office manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for this tribal-dominated region bordering Madhya Pradesh. It is part of the expansion of transport infrastructure following the creation of several new districts in Gujarat.
address: ARTO Office, Fatehpura Road, Behind State Bank, Chhota Udepur, Gujarat
